//: One number per fli check rule id — the count that may never rise. Absent = 0 = clean. `fli check --update` locks in an improvement and cannot raise; `fli check --adopt` records what is there, which is the verb for taking debt on. The findings still print either way.
//css-class-collision: Three. .field in atlas/decide and .cluster in workbench/index were inherited from basecamp with the move. .screen in routes/_module.mesa is the kit's own Screen element: on a phone it drops the Screen's side pad, which stacked with the container's to 40px a side.
//package-model-drift: One: db/schema.lite's Notification.userId is Int with a relation to Member, where @frontierjs/notifications' fragment says String for auth's uuid ids. Workbench has no auth package and Member.id is Int; the drift is the one column, on purpose (IDEAS/workbench-package.md 3.2).
//polymorphic-subject: One: Notification.subjectType is the fragment's bare String; the one kind Workbench sends (AutopilotReport) has no subject row to point at.
//service-as-system: One: api/src/domain/job/job-context.ts runs a job as the app through asSystem(). Workbench has one Member and no tenancy, so there is no other user's row to cross; the job runs as the machine's owner.

allow.boolean-prefix:db/schema.lite:ChannelMem: A @@mirror column the chat sync fills from conduit-mattermost's mirror, whose muted reads Mattermost's notify_props.mark_unread. A mirror keeps its source's names, so a rename belongs in the connector, not here.
allow.boolean-prefix:db/schema.lite:Profile.st: A @@mirror column the chat sync fills from conduit-mattermost's StatusRow.manual (Mattermost's manual status flag). A mirror keeps its source's names, so a rename belongs in the connector, not here.
allow.boolean-prefix:db/schema.lite:Team.allow: A @@mirror column the chat sync fills from conduit-mattermost's mirror, which keeps Mattermost's allow_open_invite as allowOpenInvite. A mirror keeps its source's names, so a rename belongs in the connector, not here.
allow.service-as-system:api/src/domain/chat/fo: Correct: raiseDue runs only from the chat-followup job, a cron with no caller. Each FollowUp row names the member it belongs to, and the notice goes to that member alone.
allow.service-as-system:api/src/domain/chat/sc: Correct: sendDue runs only from the chat-scheduled job, a cron with no caller. It claims each due ScheduledPost and sends it through posts.create as the row's own member, on that member's chat token.
allow.test-port-literal:api/test/workbench.tes: 8020 and 8120 are fixture values asserting that createWorkbench passes an env PORT through; the test binds nothing. Inherited from basecamp's baseline with the move (IDEAS/workbench-package.md 2.1).
